description: Enhanced HTML table with sorting, filtering, pagination, row expansion, and selection

attributes.name: data-label-no-results
attributes.description: Text for the visible empty state and the live-region announcement when the filter matches no rows.

structure.description: Standard HTML table — the component enhances it in place

childAttributes.name: data-filterable
childAttributes.description: Enable text search filtering (adds a search input above the table)

childAttributes.name: data-paginate
childAttributes.description: Enable pagination with N rows per page

childAttributes.name: data-sort
childAttributes.description: Enable sorting on this column with the specified comparator

childAttributes.name: data-weight
childAttributes.description: Column weight; multiplier applied to cell values for weighted-sum rollups

childAttributes.name: data-rollup
childAttributes.description: Compute this column's cells from sibling cells in the same row

childAttributes.name: data-heatmap
childAttributes.description: Tint this column's cells by relative value bucket (low/mid/high)

childAttributes.name: data-sort-value
childAttributes.description: Custom sort value overriding cell text. Use for formatted values, e.g. $1,234 — data-sort="number" parses the cell with parseFloat, so "$1,234" would sort as 0

childAttributes.name: data-filter-value
childAttributes.description: Custom filter value overriding cell text

childAttributes.name: data-expandable
childAttributes.description: Mark row as expandable (followed by a data-expand-content row). Supply the toggle yourself: <button data-action="toggle-expand"> in a cell; the component manages aria-expanded

childAttributes.name: data-expand-content
childAttributes.description: Hidden row revealed when its preceding expandable row is toggled

childAttributes.name: data-selectable
childAttributes.description: Mark row as selectable via an author-supplied <input type="checkbox" data-action="select-row">; a thead checkbox with data-action="select-all" toggles all

events.name: data-table:sort
events.description: Fired when a column is sorted

events.name: data-table:expand
events.description: Fired when a row is expanded or collapsed

events.name: data-table:rows-changed
events.description: Fired after each .rows assignment with keyed-diff stats (source: 'api')

properties.name: rows
properties.description: Row records. Seeded from <tr data-id> on upgrade; assigning runs a keyed diff that preserves <tr> nodes whose id persists.

properties.name: columns
properties.description: Column spec derived from <thead> (th data-key, else lowercased header text).

properties.name: renderRow
properties.description: Optional custom row renderer used for new rows in .rows assignments.

properties.name: totalPages
properties.description: Total pages for the current filter (1 when not paginated).

properties.name: totalCount
properties.description: Total data rows (expansion content rows excluded).

methods.name: goToPage(page)
methods.description: Navigate to a page (1-indexed, clamped). No-op without data-paginate.

methods.name: setFilter(query)
methods.description: Set the filter text programmatically (updates the search input) and announce the result count.

methods.name: refresh()
methods.description: Re-scan rows after DOM changes and re-apply rollups, heatmaps, filter, sort and pagination.
